entities.name: Mynyddog Mwynfawr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mynyddog Mwynfawr was, according to Welsh tradition founded on the early Welsh language poem Y Gododdin, a Brittonic ruler of the kingdom of Gododdin in the Hen Ogledd.
